parameters.content:
## Job closeout → social post

Fires when a job is marked complete in the CRM. Turns the CompanyCam before/after photos into a queued post and hands it to workflow 01 to publish.

This workflow deliberately contains **no platform API calls**. Facebook, Instagram and Google mechanics live in workflow 01 only — this one produces content, that one ships it.

### Calling it

```
POST {N8N_URL}/webhook/dr-job-completed
X-DR-Signature: <hex hmac-sha256 of body, key = CRM_AUTOMATION_KEY>

{
  "jobId": "job-1042",
  "city": "Orange Park",
  "roofType": "architectural shingle",
  "damageCause": "wind",
  "crewDays": 1,
  "photos": {
    "before": ["https://.../before-1.jpg"],
    "after":  ["https://.../after-1.jpg"]
  },
  "customerConsented": true
}
```

`customerConsented` is required and must be true — no homeowner's roof goes on social without it.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ accepted: true, jobId: $('Build Brief').item.json.jobId, postId: $('Enqueue in CRM').item.json.post?.id ?? null, platforms: $('Build Brief').item.json.platforms, note: 'Queued and handed to the publisher. Check the CRM for the compliance outcome.' }) }}
